title: Enterprise data residency & SCC compliance — pricing and packaging implications
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Objective: Produce a concise set of standard contract clauses and commercial guidelines to support sales and pricing experiments for customers requiring strict data residency and EU/UK data transfer controls. Scope includes: subprocessors disclosure & controls, data retention windows and deletion guarantees, EU/UK Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) adoption and implementation notes, permitted redlines for sales, pricing/packaging recommendations for residency guarantees (hosted EU-only, dedicated EU pools, private VPC/on-prem), and product requirements to enable contractual commitments (audit logs, region pinning, KMS integrations).

Background: Increasing RFPs and security questionnaires are requesting hard residency guarantees and SCC-based lawful transfer mechanisms. Sales has started requesting template language and a clear pricing rubric for residency add-ons. We need a single source of truth: DPA clauses + one-pager for sales + conservative allowed redlines + mapping to product capabilities so Engineering/Product can prioritize implementation work.

Deliverables: (1) DPA excerpt covering subprocessors, retention, deletion, cross-border transfers (SCCs) and breach notification timelines; (2) Sales guidance / negotiation cheat-sheet with allowed redlines and fallback language; (3) Pricing/packaging options and experiment plan (e.g., residency add-on price bands, SLA tiers, minimum commitments); (4) Short product requirements doc listing features required to honor commitments (region pinning, dedicated pools, audit log retention, KMS/HSM integration); (5) Definitive list of subprocessors and subprocessors change-notice process.
acceptance_criteria: Signed-off DPA excerpt covering subprocessors, retention, SCCs, breach notification by Legal
Sales one-pager with allowed redlines and escalation path published to Drive
Pricing proposal with 3 packaging options (hosted-EU, dedicated-residency, private deployment) and expected unit economics
Product requirements ticket created for each implementation item (region pinning, KMS, extended audit logs) and triaged by ENG
Subprocessor list published and automated notification process documented
comments: 2026-02-16 — Kickoff: Met with Legal (Priya S.) and Sales Ops (Jon K.) to align scope. Legal emphasized SCCs + DPA must reference Commission Implementing Decision 2021/914 and its UK equivalent. Sales requested a one-page pricing rubric to trial with two enterprise prospects next quarter.

2026-02-18 — Legal draft 0.1 uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xExampleDPA (internal). Key open: whether to commit to 'EU-only processing' for hosted customers vs. offering region pinning as a paid feature. Legal prefers avoiding absolute 'EU-only' guarantee on hosted unless backed by dedicated pool SLA.

2026-02-20 — PM note: Eng capacity required for 'region pinning' + 'audit log retention to 7 years' feature. Raised ENG-2123 to track engineering work. Pricing team to estimate cost delta for dedicated EU pool vs. hosted-residency add-on.

2026-02-24 — Pricing experiment draft: three tiers proposed — (A) Residency add-on (soft guarantee) at +30% unit price, (B) Dedicated EU capacity (SLA-backed) at +70% with min commit, (C) Private/on-prem (enterprise quote). Requesting finance model from Lina (Finance) by 2026-02-28.

2026-02-25 — Security questionnaire pattern: Customers ask for subprocessor change notification within 30 days, 90-day retention as default, and SCCs + DPA. Proposed retention matrix: logs 90 days (hosted) / 1 year (dedicated) / configurable (private). Legal flagged that 90 days may be too short for certain regulated customers — need escalation path.
2026-02-27 — Design/Console impact: need toggle in Redwood Console to display 'Data residency guarantee' on customer billing page and contract artifacts. Created DES-431 for mockups.

2026-02-28 — Legal review meeting: agreed on DPA baseline with optional Annex for SCCs that references standardized SCC text; Sales may append the Annex when customer requires. Legal will accept limited redlines: change of notice timelines, explicit subprocessors list updates, and tagging of processing locations. Any requests to modify transfer mechanism (SCC text) escalate to Priya.

2026-03-01 — PM update: Consolidated materials to Drive and shared with Sales leadership. Next steps: finalize pricing bands after Finance input, confirm engineering estimates, schedule legal sign-off on final DPA by 2026-03-10.
